name: openspec_source_resolve
description: Resolve the safe local OpenSpec source and the repository that owns its isolated implementation worktree.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the workspace git checkout that will own the run worktree; required unless useSpecSourceWorkspace selects a local specSource as the workspace.

specSource.description: OpenSpec source location: an absolute or file:// local path, a git URL, or a public HTTPS archive URL (.zip, .tar.gz, or .tgz).

changeId.description: OpenSpec change identifier; must be lowercase kebab-case.

specSourceType.description: Force the source type instead of inferring it from specSource.

useSpecSourceWorkspace.description: If true, use the local specSource's own git checkout as the run workspace instead of repoPath; supported only when specSource is a local path.

specPath.description: Repository-relative path hint used to locate the OpenSpec project root when it is not at the source root.

useSpecSourceWorkspace.description: Echo of the requested useSpecSourceWorkspace input.

workspaceRepoPath.description: Git checkout that will own the run worktree: repoPath, or the local specSource's own repo when useSpecSourceWorkspace is true.

sourceRepoPath.description: Git repository root containing the local specSource, if any; empty for non-local sources or a local source outside any git checkout.

sourceProjectRelativePath.description: Path of the OpenSpec project root relative to sourceRepoPath; empty when sourceRepoPath is empty.

sourceOpenSpecRelativePath.description: Path of the openspec/ directory relative to sourceRepoPath; empty when sourceRepoPath is empty.

materializeLocalSource.description: True when the local OpenSpec source should be copied into the run worktree because it shares the workspace's git identity, or is itself becoming the workspace.

publishOnVerify.description: True when the OpenSpec change and its writeback repository must be published back after verification.

warning.description: Human-readable caveat, e.g. that repoPath was ignored in favor of the source workspace; empty when there is none.
